claim: Patchline ships a cost-benefit decision model monetizing prevented incidents against reviewer time with intervals. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the cost-benefit decision claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make cost-benefit-decision-model-gate`.
